scope: Offline native daily oracle and imitation implementation; no real market experiment was run here.
original_financial_sources: Unchanged. Main thread must check compatibility with its current E6 code and bound inputs.
dependencies: existing quant account and investment modules
tests: bash scripts/cloud_research.sh .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_resumable_perpetual.py tests/test_native_action_teacher.py tests/test_native_action_inputs.py --basetemp=/workspace/coin-state/tests/native-action
synthetic_probe: Create an options JSON containing {"days":3}, then run: python -m modules.native_action.runner probe --adapter modules.native_action.synthetic:build --options OPTIONS.json --output NEW_PROBE.json --day-index 1 --limit-seconds 60

production_adapter.context_at: decision_us -> DayContext with current-only market13, E6 targets/eligibility, availability clocks, past_returns30 and frozen identities.
production_adapter.mapper: (previous_budget,desired_request,DayContext) -> Proposal; use the exact current frozen E6 ramp/risk mapper.
production_adapter.baseline_at: (simulator,DayContext) -> the exact original feasible STATE proposal. Local replay retains that actual branch.
production_adapter.npz_binding: BoundE6Inputs(path,sha256,field_map,binding); explicit field mapping. Validate original desired->ramp->nettarget path before local replay.
production_adapter.reference_mapper: linear_ramp_risk_mapper is a tested reference adapter; equivalence to the current E6 mapper is not claimed.

oracle_scope: Six native one-hot requests, each through the same L1<=0.1 ramp and risk mapper. One-step greedy on its own continuous wallet state; no global optimum claim.
local_scope: Six requests plus the exact actual selector proposal at actual selector states. Local regret is not a realizable equity curve.
terminal: Common charged final-day cash exit. Forced terminal day is excluded from optimizable training labels.
imitation: One fixed gap-weighted six-output ridge fit on matured 2024H1 native rewards. Argmax request through the same ramp/mapper. Aug13-Jan2 is previously seen temporal evaluation; train-only student-state relabel hook rejects evaluation states.
remaining_checks: Main thread owns real inputs and must verify whole-window/day-continuation equality and original saved budget/nettarget equivalence.
Run authorized first/later-day native probes before the full market oracle. Trusted forks copy mutable journal history without from_snapshot replay; actual late-day copy cost is not measured here.
This scheduler covers the daily-target E6 route; event_strategy and position_protection adapters are not included.
